digest.component_or_area: MCP on-box exposure, auth, autodeploy, and certified-op routing
propositions: An accepted ADR decision record must document how a self-contained rebar MCP HTTP server runs on the AWS box behind nginx /mcp/ TLS edge with static bearer PAT auth, mirroring the documented mcp-auth.md recipe.

The MCP autodeploy target must follow a blue-green immutable-release pattern with atomic nginx upstream pointer swap and retire-when-idle logic, decoupling retirement from deploy to avoid saturation gotchas present in the review-bot stop-and-drain pattern.

MCP-issued plan-review and completion-verifier certs must be signed under the box's existing REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID and trusted-env environment, not a distinct new env_id, preserving the single-valued verify.require_environment gate from ADR 0049.

The ADR must name concrete config keys (transport, http_tls_at_edge, auth_resource_server_url, static verifier mode) and cross-reference ADR 0049, ADR 0050, ADR 0079, and the local main-tracking updater precedent.
